brief: THE BET — take the swing: a 150–300-line diff is expected and welcome. The cross street (XS_R0..XS_R1, rows 0..64) carries nothing bigger than a cyclist (`a.kind = 'cyclist'`, spawned in spawnLaneAgent ~line 2462). Add a horse-drawn cart: its own arrival source (never a share of laneCap — spawnTapAgent/spawnCafeAgent are the model), entering from the north end of the road at a morning hour off sunUp, driving south at a slow walking pace, STOPPING at the allotment gate (ALT_GATE) where a gardener with a basket (a.crop, harvestPlot) loads it, and on market days (marketActive) a second stop at the lane end where the stalls stock from it — then out by the south edge. Draw it as two items (a body drawn before the walkers' row, the near wheel and the horse's legs after — the raised-surface law) so pedestrians read as passing it. Walkers and cyclists yield: reuse the bicycle-bell dodge. One R() for whether it comes today, hashed per day like isBandDay(); it comes most days. Name it in nameAt/personName ('the carter and his horse'). At night it does not exist. The mill (MILL, c117) has no miller — if there is room, sacks on the cart's bed on the days after a wet spell are the cheapest way to give the mill an output without an agent.
successLooksLike: From the wide shot at 09:00 on a summer day a cart and horse are on the cross street, stopped at the allotment gate with a gardener beside it; ten minutes of sim later it is gone south. probes/cart-day.mjs: 10 seeds × 4 d, arrivals per day, stop durations, and a count of walkers within 1 cell (must be 0 — nobody inside the cart).
avoid: Do not put it on the lane (LANE_N_Y is a footway with tables) or over the footbridge. Do not spawn it from laneCap. Do not draw it as one item — a walker will vanish behind it or walk through its body. Do not make it a bus/van: the town is pre-motor.
